methodologyNotes: Products were selected from high-search electric smoker models; Masterbuilt Gravity Series 800 was excluded as it is a charcoal/gravity-fed unit, not an electric smoker. Specs were sourced from manufacturer product pages (masterbuilt.com, bradleysmoker.com, pitboss-grills.com, dynaglogrill.com, smokehouseproducts.com, royalgourmetcorp.com, cuisinart.com), authorized retailer listings (Lowe's, Walmart, Amazon, Tractor Supply, Blain's Farm and Fleet, Camping World), and third-party review cross-references. Wattage values are heating-element draw in watts; cooking_space_sqin is total usable rack area in square inches; max_temp_f is the manufacturer-rated maximum cooking temperature in degrees Fahrenheit; digital_control and wifi_bluetooth and viewing_window are boolean (true = feature present, false = absent or analog); rack_count is number of included cooking racks. priceUsd reflects the lowest verified US MSRP or published retail price found at the time of research. Where manufacturer and retailer wattage figures conflict (Char-Broil 19202101, Dyna-Glo DGU732BDE-D), the manufacturer/official-retailer value was used. accessedAt 2026-06-19. This is a corrected dataset: MES 130B viewing window, Cuisinart COS-330 price, Char-Broil Deluxe wattage/source, and Dyna-Glo DGU732BDE-D wattage/price were fixed against primary sources.

The eBay product listing (model 15202043, MPN 15202043A1/15202043) corroborates the same unit — Wi-Fi/SmartChef control, "any one of four rack levels," smoker box, water pan and drip tray. Source states only "Runs on a standard 120v outlet" (voltage, not wattage) and cites 225 deg only as a smoke-duration reference, so wattage_w, max_temp_f, and viewing_window are null (none verbatim-confirmed for this exact model). eBay's structured "Number of Racks 1" and "Year Manufactured 1996" are contradicted data-entry artifacts and were not used.
